conflicts.fact: Glacier loss figures for Lewis Glacier
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: area shrank from ~1.35 km² in 1934 to under 0.20 km² in 2023 (about 85% loss of area, baseline 1934). Lesson 5: Lewis Glacier has lost over 90% of its mass since 1900 (different baseline year and measure). The datasets differ.

conflicts.fact: Delay in onset of the long rains
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: rains arrive 3–4 weeks later than in the farmer's grandfather's era. Lesson 5: Kenya Met Department records a 2–3 week delay since the 1980s.

conflicts.fact: Whether the ozone layer is part of the unit and how it relates to the greenhouse effect
conflicts.versions: Lessons 1-4 never cover the ozone layer; Lesson 5's Predict phase and model say students learned about the ozone layer and the model includes 'ozone layer filtering UV' in Lessons 1–4. Lesson 3 only has ozone as a misconception to correct. Lesson 6 introduces the ozone layer as new, and adds it to the model for the first time.

conflicts.fact: Source of moisture/rainfall mechanism for Embu long rains
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3: higher evaporation from Lake Victoria and the Indian Ocean. Lesson 4: warming over the Indian Ocean and ITCZ shift. Lesson 7 says 'East African water cycle disruption'. The sources of moisture differ (Lake Victoria added in Lesson 3).

conflicts.fact: Cause of Nairobi UV-B/ozone link to the anchoring phenomenon
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 overview says both ozone depletion and greenhouse effect are 'worsened by industrial chemicals' and frames the anchoring phenomenon as 'UV levels in Nairobi rising even as we try to reduce warming', while the Observed data shows UV-B declining after 2000 and Lesson 3 says nothing connecting it; ozone role is placed 'in the troposphere' vs stratosphere consistent. Framing of rising UV conflicts with the declining trend.

conflicts.fact: Number of lessons/timing in the sequence
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 is 80 minutes and Lesson 6 is 80 minutes, while Lesson 7 is a 40-minute capstone; Lesson 7 says 'six lessons' of evidence in the timeline and also 'seven lessons' of investigating.
